verdict.rationale: Baseten has dedicated docs for structured outputs enforcing JSON schemas ('Structured outputs let you generate text that conforms to specific JSON schemas, providing reliable data extraction and controlled text generation') plus function/tool calling support, and shows integration with LangChain's with_structured_output via its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of schema-conformance reliability and detail on grammar-based constraints beyond JSON schema.
